create_nested_tensor_from_tensor_list: create a NestedTensor by padding a list of same-channel images to the same size with a boolean mask
build_nested_tensor_object: build a NestedTensor object wrapping a tensor and an optional mask tensor for batched image processing
test_is_dist_avail_and_initialized: test whether distributed training is available and properly initialized in a PyTorch process group
refactor_nested_tensor_to_device: refactor a NestedTensor to move its tensors and mask to a specified device such as CUDA
summarize_nested_tensor_decompose: summarize how to decompose a NestedTensor back into its raw tensor and mask components
